fact: The team failed to physically return tyres to the appointed tyre supplier before the start of the Qualifying session. Infringment Breach of Article 30.4 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), who stated that it was a team oversight for which they accepted responsibility.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Tyre Return After P3
